preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.savedAutomatically: Changes are saved automatically on this computer.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Check for new releases in the background. Downloads and installation stay under your control.

launchAtLogin.label: Launch at sign-in
launchAtLogin.description: Start DiskPond in the tray when you sign in so scheduled backups can run.
launchAtLogin.unavailable: Available in installed builds of DiskPond.

keepRunningInBackground.label: Keep running when the window closes
keepRunningInBackground.description: Continue backups in the tray. When off, closing the window quits DiskPond and stops backup and restore tasks.

interfaceScale.label: Interface size
interfaceScale.description: Adjust the size of text and controls throughout the app.

reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
reduceMotion.description: Limit interface animations and transitions. Your system's reduced-motion preference is also respected.

mode.label: Backup policy view
mode.description: Choose the view used in the policy editor. Advanced adds compression, retention and detailed scheduling controls.

general.title: General
general.description: Choose the name shown for this vault.

delete.title: Disconnect this vault
delete.description: Remove this connection from DiskPond. Stored backups remain in your storage.

config.title: Storage config
config.description: View the storage location of this vault.
config.unavailable: Connection details are unavailable. Reconnect the vault to view them.
config.credentialsHidden: Passwords, keys and other credentials are kept in DiskPond's credential storage. URLs show only the server address.

throttle.title: Network throttle
throttle.description: Throttle the network usage of this vault.

enabled.label: Limit upload bandwidth
enabled.description: Cap how quickly this vault can send backup data.

limit.label: Upload limit
limit.description: Limit the upload bandwidth of this vault.

enabled.label: Limit download bandwidth
enabled.description: Cap how quickly this vault can download restore data.

limit.label: Download limit
limit.description: Limit the download bandwidth of this vault.
